create_IntervalIndex_from_breaks: create an IntervalIndex from an array of split points defining adjacent non-overlapping intervals
create_IntervalIndex_from_arrays: create an IntervalIndex from separate left and right bound arrays with a specified closed side
create_IntervalIndex_from_tuples: create an IntervalIndex from an array-like of two-element tuples representing interval bounds
build_interval_range: build a fixed-frequency IntervalIndex with evenly spaced intervals over a numeric or datetime range
test_IntervalIndex_get_loc: test the IntervalIndex get_loc method to find integer location, slice, or boolean mask for a requested label
test_IntervalIndex_contains: test the IntervalIndex __contains__ method to check if an Interval key is present in the index
test_IntervalIndex_intersection: test the IntervalIndex intersection method to compute the set intersection with another IntervalIndex
test_IntervalIndex_overlaps: test the IntervalIndex overlaps method to check whether two intervals share a common point
test_IntervalIndex_is_overlapping: test the IntervalIndex is_overlapping property to determine if any intervals share a common point
summarize_IntervalIndex_properties: summarize the IntervalIndex left, right, mid, and length properties that expose interval bounds and geometry
